newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Bangchak awards high sulphur crude in tender.
newsitem.headline: Thai Bangchak awards high sulphur crude in tender.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc has awarded a cargo of high sulphur MidEast crude but did not award any Oman cargoes in its January buying tender, a refinery source said on Friday.
The source declined to reveal details, but said up to three MidEast high sulphur cargoes had been offered.
Industry sources said two Oman cargoes were offered into the tender at around MPM plus 20 cents and one Masila cargo had been offered on a Dubai related price.
The refinery source said "we have no more requirements for PG (Persian Gulf) crude."
The refinery is negotiating to buy a Tapis cargo. Two offers were made at around a $1.00 premium to APPI, sources said.
A Belida cargo had been offered into the tender at ICP plus $1.00 premium and some Australian grades were also offered.
The tender closed on Wednesday and was valid until late on Thursday.
Bangchak awarded one million barrels of Oman crude in its December buying tender and later acquired a cargo of Tapis through negotiation.
